steps.name: Unplanned meeting (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Medea] in 「Kali」, defeat [Lethe of Oblivion] at 「Lake of Oblivion」 and obtain <Tears of Welcome>. Then report to [Beled] in “Phobos.”

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Welcome, %s. What brought you here?
(Medea welcomes you with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Was that person the one who showed such joy?)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Why are you so dazed? Didn't you have something to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… . Rather, I just wanted to say thank you for helping me with the minuet.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hehe, what is it? It's no big deal. Now, let’s have a cup of tea and talk about something else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You know the name of this car.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, you gave me tea before... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh my, I told you your name. Well, here it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You are an interesting person. Now, go ahead and eat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels different than usual, I guess it's not Medea...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I have a lot of doubts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, Kali’s mood is strange.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You didn't put the tea in your mouth. I think you must have been suspicious as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not Medea. you… . It certainly seems like they copied the way they spoke, but... .
(Medea's appearance slowly disappears like an illusion.)
My beloved Medea was away for a moment. I only came because I wanted to see the village of our clan that that child had built, and I had no other intention.
Plus, I knew how much you trusted him. I could feel the child’s trust.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you… .

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: I might be the person you know.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: See you later then. I'm sorry you have so much work to do... . Even just what Weiss is trying to do will be too much.

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: Oh, I hid ‘Tears of Welcome’ at the lakeside in Jisk’s territory to give to you. Go find it… . If you want to know how it is used, ask the tempting devil... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's gone... .
(As the woman's voice disappears, the strange atmosphere that filled Kali also returns to its original state.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The lakeside of Jisk territory, and the tempting devil, Beled...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At this point, I should know… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you want to tell me... .

steps.name: Unplanned meeting (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Lethe of Oblivion] at “Lake of Oblivion” and obtain <Tears of Welcome>. Then report to [Medea] in Kali.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Welcome, %s. I still had something to talk about, so I came looking for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I also came because I have something to talk about. But you found me?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yeah. It's not about my beauty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a good thing... . no. sorry.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I know very well that you lack aesthetic sense, so you don't have to feel sorry. Peonia told me to praise you the next time I see you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Is this a compliment?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yeah. It's a compliment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha… . So what is the story you want to talk about?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: No, you talk first. It's not like he just came here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, take this. Someone told me to take this to Beled.
(Beled accepts the tears of welcome and looks at them.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: This was it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Do you know?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I recently had a dream of a being who was my master. Asmodea... , he was holding this. He was happy, saying that the tears of welcome would make his wish come true faster.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this a common memory between Beled and Asmodea?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm not sure. Is it a real memory or a phantom dream... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Asmodea is gone. I can't feel anything in the well that was the passage to Rosengarten. So I need to know.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Was he kicked out, came out to have fun, or did he come here on his own? . I don't know anything.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I am a being made of unorganized memories and magic stones. Maybe this might be a clue.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The person who asked me to look for this said I would find out if I brought it to Beled.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: who is that person?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know either.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yeah? %s, I want to use this, is it okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. That's what Beled came to tell me to do. But how do you use this? Uh, Beled?
(Beled places a tear of welcome on the rose pendant. Then a purple light begins to circle around him.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: … This is also an item made from Vice's magic stone. Like me... . It's resonating... . I think I know a little bit... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I wanted to see a little more, but I guess this was the limit. It's gone. Sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you find out something? Can you tell me?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Even if it's a little vague, I'll tell you. The magic stone that Weiss had was not an ordinary magic stone. After extracting magical energy from life, refining it, inserting it and putting the soul into it.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Those souls were not possessed by dream demons, but were created by witches and inserted into them at will. So my memory is a mess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Witch… .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I, a doll created by mixing the power of Asmodea and the magic stone that a witch put her soul into.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: If things had gone as planned, he would have woken up, filled Asmodea's missing soul, and been abandoned. But I guess I was lucky enough to survive because the witch was playing a prank on me.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: If it was a prank like that, Asmodea and Weiss would have noticed... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Thank you. It was helpful. This is all I found out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You look somewhat regretful. What if there is nothing you want to know? Shall we talk about beauty instead?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … are you okay.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You don't have to decline, but Peonia told me not to, so I won't.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The person who hid this must be a witch, right? If I see you deliberately provoking me... .

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The witch delivered a message to you through me. I want you to get the same thing and give it to the child you love.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I guess I need one more tear of welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (My beloved child….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Maybe there's another one hidden in the same place. Thank you, Beled. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Ah, it's already gone. I was going to talk about %s's soul... . Can we not talk about it?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: First, let’s take care of the blown away tent… .

steps.name: Unplanned meeting (3)
steps.objective: Visit [Shinic] in the “Underground City of Tartarus.”

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's you. I said I would call you separately, but you still came.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness. It's Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: When was I ever not myself... .
(Mediah nods as if she notices something.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Give me what you have. and…

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What did you say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He told me to give it to my beloved child.

(Medea receives the tears of welcome and holds them carefully in her hand. After a while, Medea whispers in an unknown language and they spread like water droplets, circling around and then disappearing.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … This is someone you really don't know even if you know them. He… .  I don't even know what I'm thinking... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sorry. I met him while he was away... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I just wanted to say thank you for helping me with the minuet... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will go back.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You probably have questions, but don't you ask?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll wait.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you wait... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think you are looking for a way.
(Medea is a little surprised, but soon returns to her calm expression.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That's interesting. After all, you are... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: However, I'm just sorry that it's not right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm a little curious, what is the level of my trust?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: On your way, please say hello to Shinik and say I am well. And you don't have to worry too much about me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You’re avoiding answering. I can’t help it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. I'd like to say hello to Shinik. See you next time then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I didn't plan on going to Tartarus, but I'll give it a try...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … I hope that nothing bad will happen to the goddess, so please take care of yourselves... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Beynon… .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Did you call me?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think he appeared because my choice was too late. I will also be away from my seat for a bit longer.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So, we are trying to strengthen the barrier a little more. It'll be okay, right?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Of course it's okay. Because it's Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Baynon. Then I will prepare.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: (Now he just has to get through the bitter snowstorm...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, here we come. Are you here?♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Shinik.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The power I feel has definitely changed. The goddess's protection has become stronger.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm not sure exactly... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hmm… . Sniff. Sniff… . The smell has also gotten less.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth does that smell to me... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: A boring smell♡ … You know now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I am a boring person... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Medea asked me to say hello.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Have you been to Cali? okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what were you doing? I don't think it's fun.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: People can't live only doing fun things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There’s something strange about Shinik saying something like that… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I can make something boring right away, shall I show you?♡
(Shinyik holds out the sparkling Death Scythe.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … no. no. I was wrong.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Okay ♡ It's not a big deal right now, I just thought I'd release some of the magical power I had sealed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I had nothing to use so I sealed it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Not right away, maybe someday? Don’t worry♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's a sealed power... It's kind of scary, but don't worry... Is this a joke? I have no idea...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melbig made frilling curry for dinner tonight, so eat it. I haven't heard of Free Ring, so don't worry!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Shinik. I was really hungry, so I'll eat well and leave.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll be there a little later, so go to Melbig first. Okay? Oh, please tell me to draw a free ring shape on the plate♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm starting to get hungry. Should I just clean up and go?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When you think about it, people are really interesting. Even if you don’t feel like it… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Even though it's painful, I'm hungry.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Now what’s left for %s is the power of Io and Mediah?)
